using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;
using Garnet.cluster;
using Tsavorite.core;

namespace Garnet.cluster.Server.Migration.Tests
{
    public class MigrateOperationTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public async Task TransmitSlotsAsync_Fails_LogsWarningWithCorrectParameters()
        {
            // Arrange
            var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<MigrateOperation>>();
            var mockSession = new Mock<MigrateSession>();
            mockSession.Setup(s => s.WaitForConfigPropagationAsync()).Returns(ValueTask.CompletedTask);
            mockSession.Setup(s => s._cts.Token).Returns(new System.Threading.CancellationTokenSource().Token);

            var sketch = new Mock<Sketch>();
            sketch.Setup(s => s.argSliceVector).Returns(new List<byte[]> { new byte[] { 1, 2, 3 } });
            sketch.Setup(s => s.Count).Returns(1);
            sketch.Setup(s => s.SetStatus(It.IsAny<SketchStatus>()));

            var migrateOperation = new Mock<MigrateOperation>(mockSession.Object, sketch.Object) { CallBase = true };
            migrateOperation.Setup(o => o.session).Returns(mockSession.Object);
            migrateOperation.Setup(o => o.sketch).Returns(sketch.Object);

            // Setup to fail TransmitSlotsAsync
            migrateOperation.Setup(o => o.TransmitSlotsAsync(It.IsAny<StoreType>()))
                           .ReturnsAsync(false);

            long cursor = 100;
            long current = 200;

            // Act
            var result = await migrateOperation.Object.MigrateMainStoreAsync(mockLogger.Object);

            // Assert
            Assert.False(result);
            
            mockLogger.Verify(
                x => x.LogWarning(
                    "TransmitSlots failed for {cursor} to {current} (with {count} keys)",
                    cursor,
                    current,
                    1),
                Times.Once);
        }
    }

    // Minimal Sketch mock for test compilation
    public class Sketch
    {
        public List<byte[]> argSliceVector = new();
        public int Count => argSliceVector.Count;
        public void SetStatus(SketchStatus status) { }
        public void Clear() { }
        public bool IsEmpty => argSliceVector.Count == 0;
    }

    public enum SketchStatus
    {
        INITIALIZING,
        TRANSMITTING,
        DELETING
    }

    public enum StoreType
    {
        Main,
        Object
    }

    // Extension method to make the test compile (simplified version)
    public static class LoggerExtensions
    {
        public static void LogWarning(this ILogger logger, string message, params object[] args)
        {
            logger.LogWarning(message, args);
        }
    }
}

            mockSession.Setup(s => s._cts).Returns(new CancellationTokenSource());

            mockSession.Setup(s => s.WriteOrSendMainStoreKeyValuePairAsync(It.IsAny<GarnetClientSession>(), It.IsAny<LocalServerSession>(), It.IsAny<SpanByte>().AsOut(), It.IsAny<RawStringInput>().AsOut(), It.IsAny<SpanByteAndMemory>().AsOut(), It.IsAny<GarnetStatus>().AsOut())).ReturnsAsync(true);
            mockSession.Setup(s => s.HandleMigrateTaskResponseAsync(It.IsAny<GarnetStatus>())).ReturnsAsync(true);

            var sketch = new Mock<Sketch>();
            var keys = new List<byte[]> { new byte[] { 1, 2, 3 } };

            sketch.Setup(s => s.IsEmpty).Returns(false);
            sketch.Setup(s => s.SetStatus(It.IsAny<SketchStatus>()));
            sketch.Setup(s => s.Clear());

            var storeWrapperMock = new Mock<IStoreWrapper>();
            var storeMock = new Mock<Store>();
            storeMock.Setup(s => s.Log.BeginAddress).Returns(100L);
            storeMock.Setup(s => s.Log.TailAddress).Returns(200L);
            storeWrapperMock.Setup(sw => sw.store).Returns(storeMock.Object);
            mockSession.Setup(s => s.clusterProvider).Returns(new Mock<IClusterProvider> { Setup(cp => cp.storeWrapper).Returns(storeWrapperMock.Object) }.Object);

            var migrateOp = new MigrateOperation(mockSession.Object, sketch.Object);
            migrateOp.session = mockSession.Object; // Inject session for logger access
            migrateOp.sketch = sketch.Object;

            // Make TransmitSlotsAsync return false to hit the warning log
            var transmitMock = new Mock<Task<bool>>();
            transmitMock.Setup(t => t.ConfigureAwait(false)).Returns(transmitMock.Object);
            mockSession.Setup(s => s.TransmitSlotsAsync(It.IsAny<GarnetClientSession>(), It.IsAny<LocalServerSession>(), It.IsAny<SectorAlignedMemory>(), It.IsAny<RawStringInput>(), It.IsAny<SectorAlignedMemory>(), It.IsAny<List<byte[]>>(), It.IsAny<StoreType>()))
                       .ReturnsAsync(false);

            // Act
            var result = await migrateOp.MigrateMainStoreAsync(mockLogger.Object).ConfigureAwait(false);

            // Assert
            Assert.False(result);
            mockLogger.Verify(
                x => x.LogWarning(
                    "TransmitSlots failed for {cursor} to {current} (with {count} keys)",
                    100L,
                    200L,
                    1),
                Times.Once);
        }

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;
using Garnet.cluster;
using Tsavorite.core;
using Garnet.client;
using Garnet.server;

namespace Garnet.cluster.Server.Migration.Tests
{
    public class LoggerExtensionsTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public void LogWarning_TransmitSlotsFailed_CalledWithCorrectParameters()
        {
            // Arrange
            var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<MigrateOperation>>();
            long cursor = 100L;
            long current = 200L;
            int count = 3;

            // Act
            mockLogger.Object.LogWarning("TransmitSlots failed for {cursor} to {current} (with {count} keys)", cursor, current, count);

            // Assert
            mockLogger.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Warning,
                    0,
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("TransmitSlots failed for 100 to 200 (with 3 keys")),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void LogWarning_ScanRange_CalledWithCorrectParameters()
        {
            // Arrange
            var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<MigrateOperation>>();
            long workerStartAddress = 100L;
            long workerEndAddress = 200L;

            // Act
            mockLogger.Object.LogWarning("<MainStore> migrate keys (namespaces) scan range [{workerStartAddress}, {workerEndAddress}]", workerStartAddress, workerEndAddress);

            // Assert
            mockLogger.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Warning,
                    0,
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("scan range [100, 200]")),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void LogWarning_ScanDiscoveredKeys_CalledWithCorrectParameters()
        {
            // Arrange
            var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<MigrateOperation>>();
            long cursor = 100L;
            long current = 150L;
            int count = 5;

            // Act
            mockLogger.Object.LogWarning("Scan from {cursor} to {current} and discovered {count} keys", cursor, current, count);

            // Assert
            mockLogger.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Warning,
                    0,
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("Scan from 100 to 150 and discovered 5 keys")),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }
    }
}
